verdict.rationale: PostHog's CLI docs explicitly state it's designed for 'your terminal, your coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines' (posthog-docs-20), and the API supports headless HTTP-based event capture from any language (posthog-docs-11), backed by a working OpenAPI spec (posthog-probe-3). This directly supports running PostHog headlessly in automated/CI contexts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of CLI or API working reliably inside a CI pipeline, and no community report validating this specific use case.
